'''Hel's Outfitting''' was a small store in [[Icecrest]], a district of [[Winterdome]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Corfai]], and owned by [[Viktor Hel/Legends|Viktor Hel]], a famous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].
